sloka: कार्ये कर्मणि निर्दिष्टे यो बहून्यपि साधयेत् ।पूर्वकार्याविरोधेन स कार्यं कर्तुमर्हति ।। ५.४१.५।।।।
transliteration: kārye karmaṇi nirdiṣṭe yo bahūnyapi sādhayet ।pūrvakāryāvirodhena sa kāryaṁ kartumarhati ।। 5.41.5।।।।

translations.english: 'He, who can perform tasks in addition to the objective accomplished without affecting it, is really worthy.
